crossRefs.note: He lived there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
When they had come to him, he said to them, “You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was…
Therefore watch, remembering that for a period of three years I didn’t cease to admonish everyone night and day with…
But I say, didn’t they hear? Yes, most certainly, “Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of…
When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word…
This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus…
John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from God, who is and who was and who is to come…
saying, “What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira…
He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath and persuaded Jews and Greeks.
how I didn’t shrink from declaring to you anything that was profitable, teaching you publicly and from house to house,
testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus.
For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who…
For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.
For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,
There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all…
where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person…

people.name: Asia
people.line: A Roman province in western Asia Minor.

people.name: Javan
people.line: Son of Japheth; ancestor of Greek people

translations.web: This continued for two years, so that all those who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.
translations.bsb: This continued for two years, so that everyone who lived in the province of Asia, Jews and Greeks alike, heard the word of the Lord.
translations.kjv: And this continued by the space of two years; so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.
translations.asv: And this continued for the space of two years; so that all they that dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord, both Jews and Greeks.
